title: Integer multiplicity is preserved by the dilation push-forward
statement: Let P, k ∈ ℕ, λ > 0 and X, Y ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^P) (GeometricCurrentOn univ k). Assume Y(ω) = X(η) for all test forms ω, η ∈ TestFormOn univ k whose underlying forms satisfy η = δ_λ^#ω := affinePullbackForm (λ·id) 0 ω (this is δ_{λ#}X(ω) = X(δ_λ^#ω), i.e. Y = δ_{λ#}X is the push-forward of X under δ_λ(x) = λx). If X is integer multiplicity, i.e. X = τ(M, θ, ξ) for some IMRep R = (M, θ, ξ) in univ of degree k (contract IMRep, IMRep.Represents, IsIntegerMultiplicity), then Y is integer multiplicity; in fact the triple (λM, θ(·/λ), ξ(·/λ)) is an IMRep in univ of degree k that represents Y. This holds in every degree k, including k = 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (lam : ℝ), 0 < lam → ∀ X Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k, (∀ ω η : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k, (η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) = affinePullbackForm (lam • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (Euclid P)) 0 (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) → Y ω = X η) → IsIntegerMultiplicity X → IsIntegerMultiplicity Y
